policies.title: Password Reset
policies.exact_source_text: Employees can reset their own password via the self-service portal at any time. If locked out after 5 failed attempts, contact IT to unlock the account manually. No approval required.

authoritative_rule.lockout_outcome: contact IT to unlock account manually

policies.title: VPN Access
policies.exact_source_text: VPN access is granted automatically to all full-time employees. Contractors require manager approval submitted via the access request form. VPN credentials expire every 90 days and must be renewed by the employee.

authoritative_rule.contractor_grant: requires manager approval submitted via the access request form
authoritative_rule.renewal_responsibility: must be renewed by the employee
approvals_required: Manager approval submitted via access request form (contractors only)

policies.title: Laptop Replacement
policies.exact_source_text: Laptops are eligible for replacement after 3 years of service, or earlier in case of verified hardware failure. Requests must be raised at least 2 weeks in advance of intended replacement.

policies.title: Asset Management Policy (Extract)
policies.exact_source_text: All company-issued hardware, including laptops and monitors, follows a standard 4-year refresh cycle from date of issue. Early replacement outside this cycle requires Finance sign-off in addition to IT approval.

authoritative_rule.hardware_scope: all company-issued hardware, including laptops and monitors

policies.title: Software Installation Requests
policies.exact_source_text: Standard software (listed in the approved catalog) can be self-installed. Non-catalog software requires IT Security review, which takes 3–5 business days.
policies.source_citation: [DataPack: KB-04 - Software Installation Requests, Page 1] § Section 1

policies.title: Printer Troubleshooting
policies.exact_source_text: For printer issues, first check the printer queue and restart the print spooler. If the issue persists after restart, log a ticket with the printer’s asset tag.

authoritative_rule.initial_troubleshooting_step: check the printer queue and restart the print spooler
authoritative_rule.escalation_condition: if the issue persists after restart

policies.title: Email Mailbox Quota
policies.exact_source_text: Default mailbox quota is 25GB. Employees nearing quota should archive old mail. Quota increases beyond 25GB require manager approval and are capped at 50GB.
policies.source_citation: [DataPack: KB-06 - Email Mailbox Quota, Page 1] § Section 1

policies.title: Guest Wi-Fi Access
policies.exact_source_text: Guest Wi-Fi credentials are valid for 24 hours and can be generated by any employee from the front-desk kiosk. No IT ticket required.
policies.source_citation: [DataPack: KB-07 - Guest Wi-Fi Access, Page 1] § Section 1

authoritative_rule.generation_method: can be generated by any employee from the front-desk kiosk

policies.title: Expense Software Access
policies.exact_source_text: Access to the expense management tool is granted by Finance, not IT. IT can only assist with login/technical issues once an account already exists.
policies.source_citation: [DataPack: KB-08 - Expense Software Access, Page 1] § Section 1

authoritative_rule.permitted_it_scope: IT can only assist with login/technical issues once an account already exists

policies.title: Security Incident Reporting
policies.exact_source_text: Any suspected phishing email, malware, or unauthorized access attempt must be reported to security@veridian-corp.example immediately and should not be forwarded to other employees.
policies.source_citation: [DataPack: KB-09 - Security Incident Reporting, Page 1] § Section 1

prohibited_actions: should not be forwarded to other employees

policies.title: Work-From-Home Equipment
policies.exact_source_text: Employees working remotely more than 3 days/week are eligible for a one-time home office equipment allowance (chair, monitor). Requires manager sign-off and Finance processing — IT only handles the equipment shipping request once approved.

authoritative_rule.allowance_scope: one-time home office equipment allowance (chair, monitor)
authoritative_rule.it_role: IT only handles the equipment shipping request once approved
